name: TeamStarWolf - The Year 2009 in Intrusions
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. ATT&CK Enterprise techniques that the verified 2009 record supports: the techniques ATT&CK lists for the ATT&CK objects S0608 Conficker, S0203 Hydraq, G0066 Elderwood and the campaign C0002 Night Dragon, and behavior described by US-CERT's Conficker alert TA09-088A, Microsoft's and Adobe's advisories and bulletins for the document and plug-in flaws exploited at release, NVD's records, the GhostNet and Shadows in the Cloud reports, the Cambridge report, McAfee's Night Dragon report and the FBI's stories on Operation Phish Phry, the ATM cash-out charges and its spear phishing warning. No 2009 source prints an ATT&CK id. The Lazarus Group technique ATT&CK dates to 2009 without a dated event and the three ATT&CK for ICS techniques it lists for Conficker are not in this layer. Each comment names source numbers from case-studies/CHRONICLE_2009.md. Scores: 100 the ATT&CK object prints the id, 70 the source describes the behavior and the study assigns the id, 40 the mapping is Inferred.
